answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 157094 Country: India Title: Wife refused to accept Husband Question: This morning, my friend’s wife said to him that, “I do not consider you my husband. You are not my husband.” She repeated this many times. Will they still be in nikah? What are effects of these words on their nikah? Please guide us in the light of Quran and Hadith? Answer ID: 157094 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 315/269/D=3/1439) If the husband only heard these sentences of his wife and said nothing, then there would be no adverse effect on their nikah. Their nikah is still intact. However, the wife should not say such words, it is rudeness. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
